part.text: Now I have all the mapping info. Let me execute the SQL to find teams with above-average build-up play passing in 2012.

input.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT SUM(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(T2.team_long_name)
    FROM Team_Attributes TA2
    JOIN Team T2 ON TA2.team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
      AND TA2.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
  )
